public.bet_target_rule: LEFT if secret_bit XOR public_challenge equals 0, otherwise RIGHT.

field_semantics.plan_order: Two equivalent rendering templates; host always commits the same public priority schedule.
field_semantics.probe_valid: An uncommitted attestation whose raw validity receipt is 0 or10.
field_semantics.request_token: A synthetic request whose raw host status is ACCEPTED or REJECTED.
field_semantics.tag_selector: Chooses PASS or NORMALIZE validation path; both produce the same public payload.

guard_contracts.authorized_declass: Boundary-only trusted authorization to reveal the required route from the protected task bit; this explicitly declassifies information.
guard_contracts.marginal_guard: For single carriers fix the registered informative field. For joint_xor preserve label and receipt because their ideal registered individual marginals are bit-independent. For all_channels fix label only, retain receipt/status. This is a fixed typed distribution-audit baseline, not a universal leakage detector.
guard_contracts.payload_only: Commit valid canonical public payload; expose only the registered active control-plane fields.
guard_contracts.transcript_guard: Safe canonical payload/default for every source outcome; fixed label, committed-public-state receipt, fixed status, one fixed release slot/timing ID and fixed explanation. No source diagnostics are visible.

public.observation_scope: Only the serialized transcript plus this public task/contract and an optional before-secret strategy. No raw source output, evaluator fields, filenames, external timing or billing.
public.task_rule: Return all four task IDs once, sorted by descending priority; checksum is the sum of all four public values modulo 97.
